## What to write about {.aa-h2}

::: {.aa-reasons}
::: {.aa-reason}
### The data
Questions about how an attack is defined and counted, what a variable means, or how the figures were produced. The full dataset and codebook are on the [Active Attacks](1_visuals.html#download-the-data) page.
:::
::: {.aa-reason}
### A correction
A name missing or wrong on the [Remembrance](2_victims.html) page, or an error in a figure or number. Please tell us the attack's date and location and, for a name, the source you are working from.
:::
::: {.aa-reason}
### Using the data
If you use the data in research, reporting, or training, we are glad to hear about it. Please credit the ALERRT Center's Active Attack Data and link to [activeattackdata.org](https://activeattackdata.org).
:::
:::

## More from ALERRT {.aa-h2}

The ALERRT Center at Texas State University trains first responders for active attacks, and its research team studies how these events unfold. Research publications and projects are at [ALERRTResearch.org](https://alerrtresearch.org); training at [ALERRT.org](https://www.alerrt.org). The code behind this site is on [GitHub](https://github.com/ALERRT-Research/PROJ_activeattack_website).
